hypotheses.claim_to_test: Observation-conditioned relative risk can reduce harmful restoration changes at matched restoration coverage while retaining gains on unknown mixed degradations.
hypotheses.mechanism: Predict candidate-versus-base error change on detached fixed candidates; independently calibrate on held-out sources. Current R_phi error variance is not this action risk and is not raw-observation noise variance.
hypotheses.mvp: freeze R_phi; compare geometry-aligned input versus R_phi before adding a fixed H3 candidate
controls: oracle action selection for diagnosis only
hypotheses.failure: Reject the claim if gains come only from almost never restoring, fail at matched coverage, disappear against fixed mixing, or survive risk-map shuffling unchanged.
hypotheses.novelty_revision: VetoNet 2026-10 directly covers frozen candidates, counterfactual relative utility and risk-based local override. Keep as control, match coverage and actual edit magnitude.

hypotheses.claim_to_test: Observation-driven history validity can reduce transition artifacts without sacrificing useful temporal evidence in stable regions.
hypotheses.mechanism: start with K3; score whether each past observation remains relevant; distinguish scene/motion changes from degradation changes; do not treat generated pixels as independent new observations
controls: oracle degradation-change reset for diagnosis only
hypotheses.failure: Reject the claim if gains arise from ignoring all history or only detecting cuts, or if stable-segment quality and temporal benefit disappear.
hypotheses.novelty_revision: Generic temporal gate overlaps LaverNet/TURTLE. Test current-query history marginal utility supervision using matched-capacity and shuffled-label arms; see parallel research plan P1.

h3_integration_gate.three_step_dc: legacy sampling events collapse to the final step; a future inner-step mechanism must beat post-decode correction at matched DiT and VAE budgets and be evaluated after final decode
h3_integration_gate.native_task_constraint: A=I hard projection to raw input restores degradation; projection to R_phi fixes the whole output to R_phi. Use explicitly named finite-strength fidelity anchors; canonical Q4 is not a known physical observation operator.
h3_integration_gate.causality: verify whole-pipeline prefix invariance or declare bounded block lookahead; causal R_phi alone does not establish causal H3
h3_integration_gate.component_parity: separately compare official pretrained latent upscaler and current pixel-upsample draft; match all selected pretrained components before attributing improvements to architecture
